content: SKILL.md frontmatter: name (required, max 64 chars, lowercase+hyphens, must match dir name), description (required, max 1024 chars, what+when), allowed-tools (optional, experimental, space-separated), compatibility (optional, max 500 chars, environment requirements), metadata (optional, string-to-string map), license (optional). Frontmatter must start at byte 0 with ---. Body: max 500 lines/5000 tokens recommended. Progressive disclosure: name+desc loaded at startup, body loaded when activated, resources/scripts loaded on-demand.
